info.title: CloudFormationGenerationAPI
info.description: API for receiving architecture explanations to generate, validate and reiterate associated AWS CloudFormation templates.

get.description: Receive architecture explanation from user and return generated AWS CloudFormation template

parameters.name: architectureExplanation
parameters.description: Architecture explanation provided by the user

cloudformationTemplate.description: AWS CloudFormation template generated based on the architecture explanation

400.description: Bad request. One or more required fields are missing or invalid.

parameters.name: cloudformationTemplate
parameters.description: Current AWS CloudFormation template to be validated

isValid.description: Indicates whether the AWS CloudFormation template is valid or not

error.description: Error message if the AWS CloudFormation template is invalid

400.description: Bad request. One or more required fields are missing or invalid.

get.description: Iteratively refine the generated AWS CloudFormation template, incorporating AWS best practices, to produce an optimized version of the CloudFormation template.

parameters.name: cloudformationTemplate
parameters.description: Current AWS CloudFormation template to be reiterated

parameters.name: architectureExplanation
parameters.description: Architecture explanation provided by the user

updatedCloudformationTemplate.description: Updated AWS CloudFormation template incorporating AWS best practices

400.description: Bad request. One or more required fields are missing or invalid.

get.description: Update instruction provided by the user to change AWS CloudFormation template

parameters.name: cloudformationTemplate
parameters.description: Current AWS CloudFormation template to be updated

parameters.name: updateInstruction
parameters.description: Update instruction provided by the user

parameters.name: architectureExplanation
parameters.description: Architecture explanation provided by the user

updatedCloudformationTemplate.description: Updated AWS CloudFormation template after applying the update instruction

400.description: Bad request. One or more required fields are missing or invalid.

get.description: Resolve error to generate a new AWS CloudFormation template

parameters.name: cloudformationTemplate
parameters.description: Current AWS CloudFormation template to be updated

parameters.name: errorInstruction
parameters.description: Error instruction to update AWS CloudFormation template

400.description: Bad request. One or more required fields are missing or invalid.
